caption: Agents board: your run is a card
line: Open the Agents board. Your running Squad is a card, with its status on it. Flow view shows the same run as a graph of who hands work to whom.

caption: Open the card: Squad details
line: Open the card to see Squad details: the goal, and progress for each step. It refreshes on its own while the run is active.

caption: Inbox: Needs your answer
line: If a worker needs a decision, the run pauses and asks you. The question waits in the Inbox, under Needs your answer.

caption: Answer, and the run continues
line: Choose an answer and continue. A question is not an error. The run was simply waiting for you.

caption: Inbox: Squad completed
line: When the work is finished, the Inbox posts Squad completed, with a short summary of the result.

caption: Open Squad details: 4/4 complete
line: Open Squad details for the full record of every step.

caption: Find it, answer it, read the result
line: That is the whole loop: find the run, answer when it asks, and read the result.
